target.name: YAH scalar arctic first-step obstruction
target.statement: Yolcu, Aaronson and Heule (2023, section 6) raise whether suitable matrix interpretations might fail to establish termination of their mixed-base Collatz rewrite system. This broad direction remains open. The restricted subquestion here is whether any standard coefficientwise dimension-one arctic-natural interpretation, with unbounded nonnegative finite coefficients, can weakly orient all eleven rules and strictly orient a nonempty first full rule-removal subset, a boundary-rule subset in the original relative-top orientation, or a dynamic-rule subset in the reversed relative-top orientation. The fixed two-state twenty-two-rule labeling is also considered. The exact scalar subquestion was not separately posed in the cited paper.
